title: [MTR4] MF88
description: The MF88 is one of the Paris Metro Trains
body:
This ressource pack adds the Paris metro **MF88** to the Minecraft Transit Railway mod.

**MTR necessited**, tested on version 4.0 or higher only ! Enjoy it, I spend a lot of time making it...

Ressource pack also integrated into the **[MTR France Addon](https://modrinth.com/mod/mtr-france-addon)** ! Check it out !

**Train specifications, for realistic experience :**

- Max Speed : 80km/h

- Authorised Max Speed : 40km/h

- Acceleration Speed : 1.0m/s²

- Decceleration Speed : 0.9m/s²

![MF88 at platform, in an aerial station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e36c60c0b1fa72d0ea89c7c05c3e0207b0aeaa56.png)
